# FastAPI Internal Architecture Guide (Unofficial)

> Source-level internal architecture guide to FastAPI v0.162.2: routing closure compilation, Dependant & solve_dependencies, Pydantic v2 bridge, ASGI middleware onion, native OpenTelemetry, and OpenAPI 3.1 synthesis.
